name: remreload
description: Automatically reload remote SSH and tunnel windows on connection loss

remreload.remoteSsh.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable connectivity checks and automatic window reloads for Remote SSH sessions.

remreload.remoteSsh.checkConnectivityCom.markdownDescription: After a Remote SSH connection is lost, run this command on the local machine until it succeeds before reloading the window. Use it to wait for network or VPN connectivity.

remreload.remoteTunnel.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable connectivity checks and automatic window reloads for Remote Tunnel sessions.

remreload.remoteTunnel.checkConnectivity.markdownDescription: After a Remote Tunnel connection is lost, run this command on the local machine until it succeeds before reloading the window. Use it to wait for network or VPN connectivity.

remreload.checkConnectivityCommand.markdownDescription: Legacy SSH connectivity command setting. Remreload migrates explicitly configured values to `#remreload.remoteSsh.checkConnectivityCommand#` on activation.
remreload.checkConnectivityCommand.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#remreload.remoteSsh.checkConnectivityCommand#`. Remreload migrates this setting automatically on activation.

remreload.logDebugLevel.markdownDescription: Controls the level of logging output. Set to 'debug' for verbose logging information.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
